method: For each ENH-* entry: re-read repo_claim / repo_files against HEAD on cursor/harness-feature-disposition-b608; cross-check five-host-reverification.md where it seeds the same fact. Atlas register status stays proposed (validator R_REGISTER). Disposition is the follow-on keep/update/deprecate decision.

legend.update: Claim or gap still present; implement (or refresh then implement) the proposal.
legend.deprecate: Do not implement; obsolete, wrong, or superseded. Leave register status proposed for audit; disposition is authoritative for backlog triage.
legend.done: Proposal already landed in HEAD; close when implementing a status enum expansion.
